subject: science
passage: Most bony fish stay afloat with a swim bladder, a gas-filled sac they can inflate or deflate to rise or sink in the water. Sharks, however, have no swim bladder and would slowly sink if they had no other way to stay up. ______ they rely partly on a large liver filled with oil, which is lighter than seawater, and partly on the lift their fins create as they swim.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The text explains that sharks lack the swim bladder that keeps most fish afloat. The last sentence tells what sharks use in place of it: an oily liver and lift from their fins. A transition that introduces a replacement or alternative is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The oily liver is not an example of sinking or of a swim bladder; it is a different way of staying afloat.
explanation.B: Correct. "Instead" shows that sharks use an oily liver and fin lift in place of the swim bladder they lack.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Similarly" would suggest sharks stay afloat the same way bony fish do, but the text says they lack a swim bladder.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "In addition" would add another feature on top of a swim bladder, but sharks have no swim bladder to add to.
